_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Official CPS/NCA source snapshots dated 2025–2026. All profiles concern adult people specifically named in UK drug cases; convictions and guilty pleas are sourced per person, while one sentence was pending at the cited date. Status is as of the cited publication, not a claim about later release, custody or whereabouts. UK region means historical conduct/prosecution only; no precise or live location, address, route, mugshot, or inferred connection is included. The network identifier groups source case cohorts, not an assertion that every pair collaborated.
